note: Reviewed reading of the Integrators tab (24 Nov 2026). Every grouping cites a literal excerpt of the provider's own cell, checked by tools/export-integrators.mjs; nothing here adds a claim the sheet does not make. Groups describe the kind of evidence, not a ranking or a quality score.

evidence_groups.label: Named project, corroborated
evidence_groups.explanation: A named customer or partner project confirmed by the customer, a partner or a joint announcement. Pilot or proof-of-concept scale unless the sources say more.

evidence_groups.label: Named project, provider-reported
evidence_groups.explanation: A named project or operated robot described by the provider itself, without customer or partner corroboration in the reviewed sources.

evidence_groups.label: Partnership announced
evidence_groups.explanation: An integration or service partnership or agreement announced by the provider, the manufacturer or both. No named end-customer completion.

evidence_groups.label: Published technical or research work
evidence_groups.explanation: Published documentation, code, lab engineering or a university-confirmed collaboration. Not a customer deployment.

evidence_groups.label: Commercial offering
evidence_groups.explanation: A described humanoid product or service offering, sometimes with a demonstrator or a proposed protocol. No named completed humanoid project.

evidence_groups.label: Simulated tests only
evidence_groups.explanation: Requested specialist exception: provider-reported simulated tests. No humanoid validation, no completed humanoid integration and no safety or unlearning guarantee.

evidence_groups.label: Humanoid scope unconfirmed
evidence_groups.explanation: Historical record kept for continuity. Reviewed sources show service-robot work but do not establish humanoid work.

int_accenture.basis: Named customer pilot reported by participating partners

int_mera.basis: provider-reported operated robot and software users

int_syntech.basis: university-confirmed collaboration; no production deployment established

int_mybotshop.basis: Published implementation documentation and teleoperation examples

int_dart.basis: no named humanoid customer deployment established

int_cosmicbrain.basis: Proposed pilot protocol; no measured deployment results published

projects.name: Novares Lens/Seseña humanoid proof of concept
projects.summary: One shared proof of concept at the automotive supplier Novares: Innov8 Robotics as system integrator and Bleu Robotics for the learning software, on Unitree hardware. Counted once.

providers.role: System integration: selection, on-site integration, functional safety, operator training and support
providers.excerpt: Novares Lens/Seseña humanoid PoC with Bleu Robotics; same case as Bleu entry
Novares Seseña PoC with Innov8; shared case, not a second deployment

projects.results_note: Each source reports its own figures, with different denominators and durations; they are shown separately and never combined.

results.excerpt: Novares reports 99.5% part handling and 60 min/200 cycles; not a long-run uptime or commercial rollout measure.
Bleu reports 206/207 parts packed over 65 min and 97.2% grasp-attempt success; these are distinct denominators.
